systems.system: BURS e-services portal and Mtax app

BWA.note: The portal and app are the revenue service's own tax channel; no wider government services stated.
Filing through digital platforms is urged, but no electronic payment of tax is stated.

facts.fact: BURS board chairperson Lesedi Senatla encouraged taxpayers to file 2025 individual returns through BURS' e-services portal and Mtax mobile app, with the filing season running 1 July to 30 September 2025.
